name: Contract Review and Knowledge Assistant
notes: Reviews five sample Venues and Events contracts and leases (or a pasted one with optional start and end dates) for obligations with owners and due dates, checklist risks, key dates across all contracts and clause-cited Q&A, and now drafts a reminder email to the other party, copyable key dates summaries and copyable answers; without AI it shows prepared sample reviews, a quick scan and clause or date search, and it assumes contract managers check every item against the clause. Reviewed for the brief and manager ready.
desc: Pulls obligations, due dates and risks out of contracts and leases, answers questions with the clauses they come from, and drafts reminders to suppliers and hirers about what they owe. Shows the key dates across every contract in one list.
tested: Playwright at 1280x800 light and 390x844 dark: obligations, filters, reminder draft (Copy email plus Draft in Outlook, edits kept after ticking), risks and clause peek and jump, Ask in one and all contracts (copy answer, date question answered from obligation dates without AI, empty question error), key dates windows with Copy summary and Draft in Outlook, paste own contract (validation and sample fill with dates), productionise panel and All AI prototypes button; no page or console errors, no horizontal scroll, no en or em dashes in visible text. AI path tested with a stand-in: invalid clause dropped with a note, dashes stripped, and names, phones and emails (including a person as the other party) masked before both the review and the question prompts.
